sourceNote: Adapted from a16z's State of Crypto thesis themes. Each entry restates the theme in our voice and asks 'why Sui specifically'. Drops EVM-only ideas. Pinned to the most recent published a16z report at planning time; refreshed when a 2026 edition lands.

ideas.title: AI agent payment rails
ideas.summary: Infrastructure for AI agents to pay each other and humans for compute, data, and services.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored transactions, zkLogin, and capabilities make agents first-class actors without seed-phrase overhead.
ideas.marketSignal: a16z lists agent commerce as a top theme; payment rails are a recurring sub-theme across crypto VC essays.

ideas.title: Decentralized physical infrastructure on Sui
ideas.summary: DePIN networks (compute, storage, sensors) where Sui is the coordination and reward layer.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's parallel execution handles high-throughput reward distribution. Walrus stores telemetry cheaply.
ideas.marketSignal: DePIN is one of the largest sectors in a16z's reports; most projects are on Solana or EVM.

ideas.title: On-chain credit underwriting with verifiable history
ideas.summary: Credit decisions backed by on-chain history, capability-scoped data sharing, and Move-enforced repayment.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities express access to credit history without doxxing the user. Move enforces repayment hooks.
ideas.marketSignal: On-chain credit is a recurring a16z theme; existing protocols rely on overcollateralization.

ideas.title: Fully on-chain gaming
ideas.summary: Game state lives entirely on chain. Composable mods. Player items are Sui objects that travel between games.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's parallel execution and object model fit game-state shape better than account-based chains.
ideas.marketSignal: On-chain gaming is a perennial thesis; throughput has been the blocker on EVM.

ideas.title: Prediction markets with sub-second resolution
ideas.summary: Polymarket-class market with finer event resolution and CLOB-style settlement.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's parallel execution plus DeepBook settlement supports tighter resolution windows than EVM.
ideas.marketSignal: Polymarket cleared multi-billion volume in 2025; no Sui-native prediction venue exists.

ideas.title: Real-world asset tokenization with verifiable redemption
ideas.summary: Tokenize T-bills, real estate, or commodities on Sui with on-chain redemption proofs.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model carries redemption state per-asset, not in a global table. Easier audit.
ideas.marketSignal: RWA is the largest single category in a16z's recent reports; ~$15B tokenized by mid-2025.

ideas.title: Stablecoin payment infrastructure for merchants
ideas.summary: Merchant-facing stablecoin checkout with on-chain settlement and off-chain UX.
ideas.fitForSui: USDC is native on Sui. Sponsored gas hides crypto from merchants and customers.
ideas.marketSignal: Stablecoin payments cleared >$10T in 2025; merchant tooling lags consumer wallets.

ideas.title: Verifiable AI inference receipts
ideas.summary: Each AI call produces an on-chain receipt with input hash, output hash, model id, and signed timestamp.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's throughput supports per-call receipts. Capabilities scope which agents can submit.
ideas.marketSignal: Provenance and trust in AI output is an active legal and regulatory theme.
